.acrc_M <- lapply(annex_crc$horizons, function(h) {
  j <- .acrc_colj(h)
  M <- cbind(vapply(annex_crc$models, function(m) annex_crc$netrisk[[m]][, j], numeric(length(.acrc_tr))),
             vapply(annex_crc$models, function(m) annex_crc$cif[[m]][, j], numeric(length(.acrc_tr))))
  colnames(M) <- .acrc_arms
  M
})
names(.acrc_M) <- as.character(annex_crc$horizons)
.acrc_n <- length(.acrc_tr)
# ---- Scoring routes, and the gate that decides which one the bootstrap uses --
.acrc_c_ref <- function(tt, ee, marker, horizon)
  unname(survival::concordance(survival::Surv(tt, ee) ~ marker, timewt = "n/G2",
                               reverse = TRUE, ymax = horizon)$concordance)
.acrc_cfit <- if (isTRUE(ANNEX_CRC_FAST_COUNTER) &&
                  exists("concordancefit", where = asNamespace("survival")))
  get("concordancefit", envir = asNamespace("survival")) else NULL
.acrc_c_fast <- function(y, marker, horizon) {
  r <- .acrc_cfit(y, marker, timewt = "n/G2", reverse = TRUE, ymax = horizon, std.err = FALSE)
  cn <- r$count
  unname((cn[["concordant"]] + cn[["tied.x"]] / 2) /
         (cn[["concordant"]] + cn[["discordant"]] + cn[["tied.x"]]))
}
.acrc_scorings <- list(cs = list(time = .acrc_tr, event = .acrc_er),
                       cr = list(time = .acrc_tw, event = .acrc_ew))
.acrc_use_fast <- FALSE
if (!is.null(.acrc_cfit)) {
  gap <- 0
  for (sc in names(.acrc_scorings)) {
    ss <- .acrc_scorings[[sc]]; y <- survival::Surv(ss$time, ss$event)
    for (hh in names(.acrc_M)) for (k in seq_along(.acrc_arms)) {
      a <- tryCatch(.acrc_c_fast(y, .acrc_M[[hh]][, k], as.numeric(hh)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
      b <- .acrc_c_ref(ss$time, ss$event, .acrc_M[[hh]][, k], as.numeric(hh))
      gap <- max(gap, abs(a - b), na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  .acrc_use_fast <- is.finite(gap) && gap < 1e-10
  cat(sprintf("annex-cr-cindex run: fast-counter equivalence gate over %d marker-scoring-horizon cells, max |concordancefit - concordance| = %.3e -> %s\n",
              length(.acrc_arms) * 2L * length(annex_crc$horizons), gap,
              if (.acrc_use_fast) "fast route accepted" else "REFUSED, falling back to concordance()"))
} else {
  cat("annex-cr-cindex run: the fast counter is unavailable or disabled; using survival::concordance() throughout.\n")
}
.acrc_score_all <- function(tt, ee, M, horizon) {
  if (.acrc_use_fast) {
    y <- survival::Surv(tt, ee)
    vapply(seq_len(ncol(M)), function(k) .acrc_c_fast(y, M[, k], horizon), numeric(1))
  } else {
    vapply(seq_len(ncol(M)), function(k) .acrc_c_ref(tt, ee, M[, k], horizon), numeric(1))
  }
}
# ---- Point estimates and the analytic covariance, one call per cell ---------
# All 2K markers on one right-hand side, so a single call returns every C and the
# full covariance, from which every paired se(delta) = sqrt(v_aa + v_bb - 2 v_ab)
# follows without another fit.
cat(sprintf("annex-cr-cindex run: point estimates for %d markers x 2 scorings x %d horizons...\n",
            length(.acrc_arms), length(annex_crc$horizons))); flush.console()
.acrc_point <- list(); .acrc_V <- list()
for (sc in names(.acrc_scorings)) {
  ss <- .acrc_scorings[[sc]]; .acrc_point[[sc]] <- list(); .acrc_V[[sc]] <- list()
  for (hh in names(.acrc_M)) {
    M <- .acrc_M[[hh]]
    dfr <- data.frame(time = ss$time, event = ss$event, M, check.names = FALSE)
    fml <- stats::as.formula(paste("survival::Surv(time, event) ~",
                                   paste(sprintf("`%s`", .acrc_arms), collapse = " + ")))
    fit <- survival::concordance(fml, data = dfr, timewt = "n/G2", reverse = TRUE, ymax = as.numeric(hh))
    est <- unname(fit$concordance); V <- as.matrix(fit$var)
    nmv <- names(fit$concordance)
    if (!is.null(nmv)) {
      ord <- match(.acrc_arms, gsub("^`|`$", "", nmv))
      stopifnot("concordance returned markers in an unexpected order" = !anyNA(ord))
      est <- est[ord]; V <- V[ord, ord, drop = FALSE]
    }
    names(est) <- .acrc_arms; dimnames(V) <- list(.acrc_arms, .acrc_arms)
    .acrc_point[[sc]][[hh]] <- est; .acrc_V[[sc]][[hh]] <- V
  }
}
# ---- The bootstrap ----------------------------------------------------------
.acrc_jobs <- list()
for (sc in names(.acrc_scorings)) for (hh in names(.acrc_M))
  .acrc_jobs[[length(.acrc_jobs) + 1L]] <- list(scoring = sc, horizon = hh)
.acrc_pilot <- local({
  M <- .acrc_M[[1]]; h <- as.numeric(names(.acrc_M)[1]); ss <- .acrc_scorings[["cr"]]
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  for (i in 1:3) { s <- sample.int(.acrc_n, .acrc_n, replace = TRUE)
    .acrc_score_all(ss$time[s], ss$event[s], M[s, , drop = FALSE], h) }
  as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")) / 3
})
cat(sprintf("annex-cr-cindex run: measured %.3f s per replicate for %d markers; %d jobs x B = %d -> about %.1f min sequential.\n",
            .acrc_pilot, length(.acrc_arms), length(.acrc_jobs), ANNEX_CRC_B,
            .acrc_pilot * ANNEX_CRC_B * length(.acrc_jobs) / 60)); flush.console()
.acrc_cluster <- NULL
if (!is.null(ANNEX_CRC_WORKERS) && as.integer(ANNEX_CRC_WORKERS) > 1L &&
    requireNamespace("future", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("future.apply", quietly = TRUE)) {
  nw <- as.integer(ANNEX_CRC_WORKERS)
  options(future.globals.maxSize = 4 * 1024^3)
  if (requireNamespace("parallelly", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat(sprintf("annex-cr-cindex run: starting %d PSOCK workers without project startup files.\n", nw)); flush.console()
    .acrc_cluster <- parallelly::makeClusterPSOCK(nw, rscript_args = "--no-init-file",
                                                  rscript_libs = .libPaths(), connectTimeout = 300,
                                                  validate = TRUE, autoStop = FALSE)
    future::plan(future::cluster, workers = .acrc_cluster)
  } else {
    future::plan(future::multisession, workers = nw)
  }
  cat(sprintf("annex-cr-cindex run: with %d workers expect about %.1f min.\n",
              nw, .acrc_pilot * ANNEX_CRC_B * length(.acrc_jobs) / 60 / nw))
}
.acrc_one_job <- function(i) {
  job <- .acrc_jobs[[i]]
  ss <- .acrc_scorings[[job$scoring]]; M <- .acrc_M[[job$horizon]]; h <- as.numeric(job$horizon)
  set.seed(ANNEX_CRC_SEED + i, kind = "Mersenne-Twister")
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, ncol(M), ANNEX_CRC_B, dimnames = list(colnames(M), NULL))
  for (b in seq_len(ANNEX_CRC_B)) {
    s <- sample.int(.acrc_n, .acrc_n, replace = TRUE)
    out[, b] <- .acrc_score_all(ss$time[s], ss$event[s], M[s, , drop = FALSE], h)
  }
  out
}
cat("annex-cr-cindex run: bootstrapping...\n"); flush.console()
.acrc_t0 <- Sys.time()
.acrc_par <- requireNamespace("future", quietly = TRUE) &&
  requireNamespace("future.apply", quietly = TRUE) && future::nbrOfWorkers() > 1L
.acrc_res <- if (.acrc_par) {
  future.apply::future_lapply(seq_along(.acrc_jobs), .acrc_one_job,
                              future.seed = TRUE, future.packages = "survival")
} else {
  lapply(seq_along(.acrc_jobs), function(i) {
    r <- .acrc_one_job(i)
    cat(sprintf("  job %d/%d (%s scoring @ %s m) done, %.1f min elapsed\n", i, length(.acrc_jobs),
                .acrc_jobs[[i]]$scoring, .acrc_jobs[[i]]$horizon,
                as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .acrc_t0, units = "mins")))); flush.console()
    r
  })
}
if (!is.null(.acrc_cluster)) {
  try(future::plan(future::sequential), silent = TRUE)
  try(parallel::stopCluster(.acrc_cluster), silent = TRUE); .acrc_cluster <- NULL
}
cat(sprintf("annex-cr-cindex run: bootstrap finished in %.1f min.\n",
            as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .acrc_t0, units = "mins"))))
annex_crc_boot <- list()
for (i in seq_along(.acrc_jobs)) {
  j <- .acrc_jobs[[i]]
  if (is.null(annex_crc_boot[[j$scoring]])) annex_crc_boot[[j$scoring]] <- list()
  annex_crc_boot[[j$scoring]][[j$horizon]] <- .acrc_res[[i]]
}
.acrc_q <- function(v, p) { f <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (length(f) < 20L) NA_real_ else stats::quantile(f, probs = p, names = FALSE) }
.acrc_se_ij <- function(V, a, b) sqrt(max(V[a, a] + V[b, b] - 2 * V[a, b], 0))
# ---- TABLE A: per model, scoring x marker ----------------------------------
annex_crc_bymodel <- do.call(rbind, lapply(annex_crc$models, function(m) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(annex_crc$horizons, function(h) {
    hh <- as.character(h); j <- .acrc_colj(h)
    an <- paste0("net::", m); ac <- paste0("cif::", m)
    pcs <- .acrc_point$cs[[hh]]; pcr <- .acrc_point$cr[[hh]]
    bcs <- annex_crc_boot$cs[[hh]]; bcr <- annex_crc_boot$cr[[hh]]
    d_cs <- bcs[ac, ] - bcs[an, ]; d_cr <- bcr[ac, ] - bcr[an, ]
    # Reconciliation with the existing cells: same estimator, but on the model's
    # OWN finite subset instead of the common one, which is how
    # `paired-delta-c-absolute-risk` computes it. Point estimate only.
    okm <- annex_crc$ok_own[[m]]
    own <- tryCatch(.acrc_c_ref(annex_crc$time_r_all[okm], annex_crc$event_r_all[okm],
                                annex_crc$netrisk_own[[m]][okm, j], h), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    data.frame(
      model = m, horizon = h, n_common = .acrc_n, n_own = sum(okm),
      readmissions_by_horizon = sum(.acrc_er == 1L & .acrc_tr <= h),
      competing_deaths_by_horizon = sum(.acrc_st == 2L & .acrc_tr <= h),
      C_cs_netrisk = unname(pcs[an]),
      C_cs_netrisk_lower = .acrc_q(bcs[an, ], 0.025), C_cs_netrisk_upper = .acrc_q(bcs[an, ], 0.975),
      C_cs_cif = unname(pcs[ac]),
      delta_marker_cs = unname(pcs[ac] - pcs[an]),
      delta_marker_cs_lower = .acrc_q(d_cs, 0.025), delta_marker_cs_upper = .acrc_q(d_cs, 0.975),
      delta_marker_cs_se_ij = .acrc_se_ij(.acrc_V$cs[[hh]], ac, an),
      C_cr_netrisk = unname(pcr[an]),
      C_cr_cif = unname(pcr[ac]),
      C_cr_cif_lower = .acrc_q(bcr[ac, ], 0.025), C_cr_cif_upper = .acrc_q(bcr[ac, ], 0.975),
      delta_marker_cr = unname(pcr[ac] - pcr[an]),
      delta_marker_cr_lower = .acrc_q(d_cr, 0.025), delta_marker_cr_upper = .acrc_q(d_cr, 0.975),
      delta_marker_cr_se_ij = .acrc_se_ij(.acrc_V$cr[[hh]], ac, an),
      delta_scoring_netrisk_point_only = unname(pcr[an] - pcs[an]),
      C_cs_netrisk_ownmask = own,
      spearman_netrisk_cif = stats::cor(annex_crc$netrisk[[m]][, j], annex_crc$cif[[m]][, j], method = "spearman"),
      B_valid = sum(is.finite(d_cr)), B_requested = ANNEX_CRC_B,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
  }))
}))
rownames(annex_crc_bymodel) <- NULL
# ---- TABLE B: pairwise paired delta C on the CIF marker --------------------
.acrc_key <- function(x) gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", x)
.acrc_prs <- utils::combn(annex_crc$models, 2L, simplify = FALSE)
annex_crc_pairs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(.acrc_prs, function(pr) {
  shared <- identical(.acrc_key(annex_crc$f_readmit_txt[[pr[1]]]), .acrc_key(annex_crc$f_readmit_txt[[pr[2]]]))
  shared_d <- identical(.acrc_key(annex_crc$f_death_txt[[pr[1]]]), .acrc_key(annex_crc$f_death_txt[[pr[2]]]))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(annex_crc$horizons, function(h) {
    hh <- as.character(h); j <- .acrc_colj(h)
    aA <- paste0("cif::", pr[1]); aB <- paste0("cif::", pr[2])
    p <- .acrc_point$cr[[hh]]; B <- annex_crc_boot$cr[[hh]]
    d <- B[aA, ] - B[aB, ]; delta <- unname(p[aA] - p[aB])
    lo <- .acrc_q(d, 0.025); hi <- .acrc_q(d, 0.975)
    se <- .acrc_se_ij(.acrc_V$cr[[hh]], aA, aB)
    data.frame(
      model_A = pr[1], model_B = pr[2], horizon = h, n = .acrc_n,
      shared_readmission_formula = shared, shared_death_formula = shared_d,
      readmissions_by_horizon = sum(.acrc_er == 1L & .acrc_tr <= h),
      competing_deaths_by_horizon = sum(.acrc_st == 2L & .acrc_tr <= h),
      C_A = unname(p[aA]), C_B = unname(p[aB]), delta_C = delta,
      delta_boot_lower = lo, delta_boot_upper = hi,
      boot_mean = mean(d[is.finite(d)]), centering_bias = mean(d[is.finite(d)]) - delta,
      point_inside_boot_ci = is.finite(lo) && is.finite(hi) && delta >= lo && delta <= hi,
      se_delta_ij = se, delta_ij_lower = delta - .acrc_crit * se, delta_ij_upper = delta + .acrc_crit * se,
      boot_over_ij_width = if (se > 0 && is.finite(lo) && is.finite(hi)) (hi - lo) / (2 * .acrc_crit * se) else NA_real_,
      spearman_rho = stats::cor(annex_crc$cif[[pr[1]]][, j], annex_crc$cif[[pr[2]]][, j], method = "spearman"),
      B_valid = sum(is.finite(d)), B_requested = ANNEX_CRC_B,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
  }))
}))

subject set; C_cs_netrisk_ownmask is the same estimator on the model's own finite subset
and is the number to reconcile against `paired-delta-c-absolute-risk`. delta_marker_cr is

point estimate only, because the two scorings do not share a risk set and cannot be paired.

Reporting the net risk instead of the CIF does not materially change readmission discrimination: the competing event rescales absolute risk without reordering subjects, so it matters for calibration and net benefit, not for the C index. Stating this explicitly is the defensible way to keep a net-risk C in the manuscript.

# The DeepSurv-informed common-grid cache is named after the prediction24 sidecar
# stem it was built from. Those sidecars get regenerated, and on 2026-08-23 the
# cache on disk was still the 2026-07-26 one while 2026-08-11 sidecars existed,
# whose `interact` formulas had grown (readmission gained 8 interactions;
# mortality gained 5 main effects and 12 interactions). Reporting arms built from
# a superseded stem is exactly the silent staleness this project cannot afford,
# so the newest COMPLETE sidecar triplet is located and compared against the stem
# in the cache filename, and a mismatch STOPS here. The fix is to re-run the cell
# `deltaCIBS-ds-common-grid`, which selects the newest stem itself and writes a
# new cache without touching the old one. Set ANNEX_DS_ALLOW_STALE_STEM <- TRUE
# only to reproduce an older table on purpose.
if (!exists("ANNEX_DS_ALLOW_STALE_STEM", inherits = TRUE)) ANNEX_DS_ALLOW_STALE_STEM <- FALSE
.ds_stem_check <- function(cache_file) {
  dir0 <- dirname(cache_file)
  suf <- c("dual_shap_ds_py", "dual_shap_ds_upd_py", "dual_shap_ds_int_py")
  pat <- paste0("^pred24.*__(", paste(suf, collapse = "|"), ")[.]rds$")
  ff <- list.files(dir0, pattern = pat)
  if (!length(ff)) return(invisible(NULL))
  stems <- unique(sub(paste0("__(", paste(suf, collapse = "|"), ")[.]rds$"), "", ff))
  complete <- stems[vapply(stems, function(s)
    all(file.exists(file.path(dir0, paste0(s, "__", suf, ".rds")))), logical(1))]
  if (!length(complete)) return(invisible(NULL))
  mt <- vapply(complete, function(s)
    max(file.info(file.path(dir0, paste0(s, "__", suf, ".rds")))$mtime),
    as.POSIXct("1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"))
  newest <- complete[which.max(mt)]
  used <- sub("^pred225_ds_common_grid__", "", sub("__v1[.]rds$", "", basename(cache_file)))
  if (identical(used, newest)) {
    message("annex: DS sidecar stem check passed; the cache matches the newest complete triplet (", newest, ").")
  } else if (isTRUE(ANNEX_DS_ALLOW_STALE_STEM)) {
    warning("annex: the DS cache was built from ", used, " but ", newest,
            " is newer. Proceeding because ANNEX_DS_ALLOW_STALE_STEM is TRUE.", call. = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop("annex: the DeepSurv-informed cache was built from sidecar stem ", used,
         " but a newer complete triplet exists, ", newest,
         ". Re-run the cell `deltaCIBS-ds-common-grid` to rebuild the cache from it, then rerun this cell. ",
         "Set ANNEX_DS_ALLOW_STALE_STEM <- TRUE only if you deliberately want the older arms.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(newest)
}

    message("annex-ibs-g: could not read ", basename(ff), " (", conditionMessage(e), ").")

  dn
}
for (dn in names(.annexg_death_models)) {
  al <- .annexg_mort_alias(dn)
  .annexg_target[[paste("mortality", al, sep = "::")]] <-
    list(outcome = "mortality", model = al, definition = al,
         family = unname(.annexg_family[[dn]]), readmit = NA_character_, death = dn)
}
# ---- 4b-bis. Optional restriction to named models ---------------------------
# ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS keeps only the arms whose MODEL is named, which is the way to
# produce one or two arms without paying for the full sweep. A readmission model
# keeps all three of its prediction definitions, so its CIF arms still pull in the
# two mortality matrices they need as the competing cause. The restriction is
# applied to the target inventory itself, so the refit list, the bootstrap and the
# completeness assertion all shrink together and cannot disagree.
# Example, the two relaxed-PH DeepSurv-informed arms only:
#   ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS <- c("ds-nph_readmit", "ds-nph_death")
if (!exists("ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS", inherits = TRUE)) ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS <- NULL
if (!is.null(ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS)) {
  .annexg_known <- unique(c(names(.annexg_readmit_models), names(.annexg_death_models),
                            unlist(lapply(.annexg_target, `[[`, "model"))))
  .annexg_bad <- setdiff(ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS, .annexg_known)
  if (length(.annexg_bad))
    stop("annex-ibs-g: ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS names models that do not exist: ",
         paste(.annexg_bad, collapse = ", "), ". Available: ",
         paste(sort(.annexg_known), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  .annexg_keep <- vapply(.annexg_target, function(t) t$model %in% ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS, logical(1))
  .annexg_target <- .annexg_target[.annexg_keep]
  stopifnot("ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS left no arms at all" = length(.annexg_target) > 0L)
  cat("annex-ibs-g: RESTRICTED to models ", paste(ANNEXG_ONLY_MODELS, collapse = ", "),
      " -> ", length(.annexg_target), " target arm(s). The table is a SUBSET; do not present it ",
      "as the full candidate comparison.\n", sep = "")
}
cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: candidate inventory | readmission models %d (%s) x %d definitions | mortality models %d (%s) | target arms %d\n",
            length(unique(vapply(Filter(function(t) t$outcome == "readmission", .annexg_target), `[[`, "", "model"))),
            paste(unique(vapply(Filter(function(t) t$outcome == "readmission", .annexg_target), `[[`, "", "model")), collapse = ", "),
            1L + length(.annexg_cif_death),
            length(unique(vapply(Filter(function(t) t$outcome == "mortality", .annexg_target), `[[`, "", "model"))),
            paste(unique(vapply(Filter(function(t) t$outcome == "mortality", .annexg_target), `[[`, "", "model")), collapse = ", "),
            length(.annexg_target)))
# ---- 4c. Which target arms are ALREADY scored -------------------------------
# The legacy bundle stores a scored point per arm, and a point is all the shared
# bootstrap needs, so any target arm it already holds costs nothing. Loading it
# here rather than at merge time is what lets the refit list below be the minimum.
.annexg_have <- list()
if (exists("ibs_dev_pairwise_points", inherits = TRUE) && is.list(ibs_dev_pairwise_points)) {
  .annexg_have <- ibs_dev_pairwise_points
  cat("annex-ibs-g: reusing scored arms from the live ibs_dev_pairwise_points.\n")
} else if (file.exists(ANNEXG_LEGACY_BUNDLE)) {
  cat("annex-ibs-g: reading the classical-annex bundle", basename(ANNEXG_LEGACY_BUNDLE), "for arms already scored.\n")
  .annexg_have <- tryCatch(readRDS(ANNEXG_LEGACY_BUNDLE)$points, error = function(e) list())
}
.annexg_have <- .annexg_have[vapply(.annexg_have, function(p)
  is.list(p) && !is.null(p$contrib_trapezoid) && !is.null(p$horizons) &&
  identical(as.numeric(p$horizons), as.numeric(ANNEXG_HORIZONS)) &&
  nrow(p$contrib_trapezoid) == .annexg_N, logical(1))]
.annexg_todo_arms <- setdiff(names(.annexg_target), names(.annexg_have))
cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: %d of %d target arms are already scored; %d must be built here.\n",
            length(.annexg_target) - length(.annexg_todo_arms), length(.annexg_target),
            length(.annexg_todo_arms)))
# ---- 5. Expected baseline strata, derived per formula ------------------------
# Imposing the ten-stratum updated2 design on every model would be wrong, so the
# count is derived from each formula against the development data. The assertion
# on every fit is what catches the 2026-07-12 failure mode, a strata() term
# silently fitted as a covariate.
.annexg_strata_calls <- function(e) {
  if (!is.call(e)) return(list())
  nm <- paste(deparse(e[[1]]), collapse = "")
  if (nm %in% c("strata", "survival::strata")) return(list(e))
  unlist(lapply(as.list(e)[-1L], .annexg_strata_calls), recursive = FALSE)
}
.annexg_n_strata <- function(f, data) {
  cs <- .annexg_strata_calls(f[[3]])
  if (!length(cs)) return(1L)
  vals <- list()
  for (cl in cs) for (a in as.list(cl)[-1L])
    vals[[length(vals) + 1L]] <- eval(a, envir = data, enclos = environment(f))
  if (!length(vals) || any(vapply(vals, length, integer(1)) != nrow(data)))
    stop("annex-ibs-g: could not evaluate the strata terms of ", paste(deparse(f), collapse = " "), call. = FALSE)
  comb <- if (length(vals) == 1L) droplevels(factor(vals[[1]]))
          else do.call(interaction, c(lapply(vals, factor), list(drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)))
  as.integer(nlevels(droplevels(comb)))
}
# ---- 6. Which dense-grid matrices are needed, and which already exist --------
# Only the arms that are NOT already scored drive a refit, and a CIF arm needs its
# readmission matrix and its mortality matrix, so the set is derived from the
# to-do list instead of being declared by hand.
.annexg_need <- list()
for (a in .annexg_todo_arms) {
  t <- .annexg_target[[a]]
  if (!is.na(t$readmit)) .annexg_need[[paste0("readmit__", t$readmit)]] <- .annexg_readmit_models[[t$readmit]]
  if (!is.na(t$death))   .annexg_need[[paste0("death__", t$death)]]     <- .annexg_death_models[[t$death]]
}
.annexg_valid <- function(S) is.matrix(S) && identical(dim(S), c(.annexg_N, length(ANNEXG_GRID))) && all(is.finite(S))
.annexg_S <- list()
.annexg_session <- list()
for (nm in names(.annexg_cif_death)) {
  if (identical(nm, "full-death")) .annexg_session[[paste0("death__", .annexg_cif_death[[nm]])]] <- "S_oof_death_full"
  if (identical(nm, "shap-death")) .annexg_session[[paste0("death__", .annexg_cif_death[[nm]])]] <- "S_oof_death_shap"
}
if ("readmit__shap" %in% names(.annexg_need)) .annexg_session[["readmit__shap"]] <- "S_oof_readmit"
for (key in names(.annexg_session)) {
  obj <- .annexg_session[[key]]
  if (key %in% names(.annexg_need) && exists(obj, inherits = TRUE)) {
    cand <- get(obj, inherits = TRUE)
    if (.annexg_valid(cand)) {
      .annexg_S[[key]] <- cand
      message("annex-ibs-g: reusing ", obj, " from the session, no refit for ", key, ".")
    }
  }
}
# ---- 7. Dense-grid out-of-fold refitting ------------------------------------
.annexg_cache_hit <- FALSE
if (!ANNEXG_REFIT && file.exists(ANNEXG_CACHE)) {
  .annexg_cc <- tryCatch(readRDS(ANNEXG_CACHE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(.annexg_cc) &&
      identical(as.numeric(.annexg_cc$meta$grid), as.numeric(ANNEXG_GRID)) &&
      identical(as.numeric(.annexg_cc$meta$horizons), as.numeric(ANNEXG_HORIZONS)) &&
      identical(.annexg_cc$meta$formula_keys, vapply(.annexg_need, .annexg_key, "")) &&
      all(.annexg_todo_arms %in% names(.annexg_cc$points))) {
    annex_ibsg_points <- .annexg_cc$points[.annexg_todo_arms]
    .annexg_arm_meta <- .annexg_cc$arm_metadata
    .annexg_cache_hit <- TRUE
    cat("annex-ibs-g: cache hit, dense-grid refitting skipped.\n")
  } else {
    cat("annex-ibs-g: cache present but its grid, horizons, formulas or arm coverage differ; rebuilding.\n")
  }
  rm(.annexg_cc)
}
if (!.annexg_cache_hit) {
  .annexg_todo <- setdiff(names(.annexg_need), names(.annexg_S))
  .annexg_exp <- vapply(.annexg_need[.annexg_todo], .annexg_n_strata, integer(1), data = .annexg_dev[[1]])
  cat("annex-ibs-g: dense-grid matrices to fit: ",
      paste(sprintf("%s (expect %d strata)", .annexg_todo, .annexg_exp), collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: %d formulas x %d imputations x %d folds = %d Cox fits on %d grid nodes.\n",
              length(.annexg_todo), length(.annexg_dev), length(.annexg_folds[[1]]),
              length(.annexg_todo) * length(.annexg_dev) * length(.annexg_folds[[1]]), length(ANNEXG_GRID)))
  flush.console()
  .annexg_cluster <- NULL
  if (requireNamespace("future", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("future.apply", quietly = TRUE)) {
    nw <- if (!is.null(ANNEXG_WORKERS)) as.integer(ANNEXG_WORKERS) else
      max(1L, min(5L, tryCatch(parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE), error = function(e) 4L) - 2L))
    options(future.globals.maxSize = max(8 * 1024^3, 3 * as.numeric(utils::object.size(.annexg_dev[[1]]))))
    if (nw > 1L && requireNamespace("parallelly", quietly = TRUE)) {
      # PSOCK workers started WITHOUT project startup files: the renv activation
      # script in this project's .Rprofile is what makes plain multisession
      # workers slow to start and occasionally fail, which is why
      # `p225-annex-ibs-classical-dev` uses this same construction.
      cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: starting %d PSOCK workers without startup files.\n", nw)); flush.console()
      .annexg_cluster <- parallelly::makeClusterPSOCK(nw, rscript_args = "--no-init-file",
                                                      rscript_libs = .libPaths(), connectTimeout = 300,
                                                      validate = TRUE, autoStop = FALSE)
      future::plan(future::cluster, workers = .annexg_cluster)
    } else if (nw > 1L) {
      future::plan(future::multisession, workers = nw)
    } else {
      future::plan(future::sequential)
    }
  }
  on.exit({
    try(future::plan(future::sequential), silent = TRUE)
    if (!is.null(.annexg_cluster)) try(parallel::stopCluster(.annexg_cluster), silent = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)
  .annexg_oof <- function(formula, expected_strata, label) {
    K <- length(ANNEXG_GRID); acc <- matrix(0, .annexg_N, K)
    for (im in seq_along(.annexg_dev)) {
      d <- .annexg_dev[[im]]; folds <- .annexg_folds[[im]]
      res <- if (requireNamespace("future.apply", quietly = TRUE)) {
        future.apply::future_lapply(folds, function(vi) {
          fit <- survival::coxph(formula, data = d[-vi, , drop = FALSE], ties = "efron",
                                 x = TRUE, y = TRUE, model = TRUE)
          bh <- survival::basehaz(fit, centered = FALSE)
          ns <- if (is.null(bh$strata)) 1L else nlevels(droplevels(factor(bh$strata)))
          list(n_strata = ns, S = matrix(as.numeric(pec::predictSurvProb(
            fit, newdata = d[vi, , drop = FALSE], times = ANNEXG_GRID)), length(vi), K))
        }, future.seed = TRUE, future.packages = c("survival", "pec"))
      } else {
        lapply(folds, function(vi) {
          fit <- survival::coxph(formula, data = d[-vi, , drop = FALSE], ties = "efron",
                                 x = TRUE, y = TRUE, model = TRUE)
          bh <- survival::basehaz(fit, centered = FALSE)
          ns <- if (is.null(bh$strata)) 1L else nlevels(droplevels(factor(bh$strata)))
          list(n_strata = ns, S = matrix(as.numeric(pec::predictSurvProb(
            fit, newdata = d[vi, , drop = FALSE], times = ANNEXG_GRID)), length(vi), K))
        })
      }
      for (j in seq_along(folds)) {
        if (res[[j]]$n_strata != expected_strata)
          stop(sprintf("%s, imputation %d, fold %d: %d baseline strata, expected %d. A strata() term may have been fitted as a covariate.",
                       label, im, j, res[[j]]$n_strata, expected_strata), call. = FALSE)
        acc[folds[[j]], ] <- acc[folds[[j]], ] + res[[j]]$S
      }
      rm(res); cat("."); flush.console()
    }
    S <- acc / length(.annexg_dev)
    if (anyNA(S)) stop(sprintf("%s: out-of-fold survival contains NA.", label), call. = FALSE)
    stopifnot(min(S) >= -1e-10, max(S) <= 1 + 1e-10)
    cat(sprintf(" %s done (%.1f min elapsed)\n", label, (proc.time() - .annexg_t0)[["elapsed"]] / 60))
    pmin(pmax(S, 0), 1)
  }
  for (mn in .annexg_todo)
    .annexg_S[[mn]] <- .annexg_oof(.annexg_need[[mn]], .annexg_exp[[mn]], mn)
  try(future::plan(future::sequential), silent = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(.annexg_cluster)) { try(parallel::stopCluster(.annexg_cluster), silent = TRUE); .annexg_cluster <- NULL }
  invisible(gc())
  # ---- 8. Exact competing-hazard CIF, with its mandatory control -------------
  .annexg_cif <- function(S_r, S_d) {
    if (!identical(dim(S_r), dim(S_d))) stop("annex-ibs-g: CIF inputs have different dimensions.", call. = FALSE)
    H_r <- -log(pmax(S_r, 1e-12)); H_d <- -log(pmax(S_d, 1e-12)); S_all <- S_r * S_d
    n <- nrow(S_r); K <- ncol(S_r); cif <- matrix(0, n, K)
    prev_S <- rep(1, n); prev_Hr <- rep(0, n); prev_Hd <- rep(0, n); acc <- rep(0, n)
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      dr <- pmax(H_r[, k] - prev_Hr, 0); dd <- pmax(H_d[, k] - prev_Hd, 0); da <- dr + dd
      frac <- ifelse(da > 0, dr / da, 0); pev <- -expm1(-da)
      acc <- acc + prev_S * frac * pev
      cif[, k] <- acc
      prev_S <- S_all[, k]; prev_Hr <- H_r[, k]; prev_Hd <- H_d[, k]
    }
    pmin(pmax(cif, 0), 1)
  }
  local({
    g <- c(0, 0.25, 1, 6, 12, 36, 60)
    Sr <- rbind(exp(-0.01 * g), exp(-0.10 * g))
    no_d <- matrix(1, nrow(Sr), ncol(Sr)); with_d <- rbind(exp(-0.02 * g), exp(-0.20 * g))
    e1 <- max(abs(.annexg_cif(Sr, no_d) - (1 - Sr)))
    e2 <- max(.annexg_cif(Sr, with_d) - (1 - Sr))
    if (!is.finite(e1) || e1 > 1e-12 || !is.finite(e2) || e2 > 1e-12)
      stop("annex-ibs-g: the exact competing-hazard CIF control failed.", call. = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: exact CIF control passed (no-death error %.3e, competing-death excess %.3e).\n", e1, e2))
  })
  # ---- 9. Score exactly the target arms that are not already scored ---------
  .annexg_mk_death <- function(S) list(S = S, grid = ANNEXG_GRID, n_imp = length(.annexg_dev),
    y_test = data.frame(time = .annexg_dt, event = .annexg_de),
    y_train = data.frame(time = .annexg_dt, event = .annexg_de))
  .annexg_mk_readmit <- function(S) list(S = S, grid = ANNEXG_GRID, n_imp = length(.annexg_dev),
    rt_val = .annexg_rt, re_val = .annexg_re, dt_val = .annexg_dt, de_val = .annexg_de,
    rt_tr = .annexg_rt, re_tr = .annexg_re, dt_tr = .annexg_dt, de_tr = .annexg_de)
  annex_ibsg_points <- list(); .annexg_meta <- list()
  .annexg_add <- function(arm, point, t) {
    point$method <- if (identical(t$outcome, "mortality")) "death" else "readmission-aj"
    annex_ibsg_points[[arm]] <<- point
    .annexg_meta[[length(.annexg_meta) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
      arm = arm, outcome = t$outcome, model = t$model,
      prediction_definition = t$definition, family = t$family, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  # The CIF is rebuilt per arm from its own two matrices. Both controls travel with
  # it: a cumulative incidence must be nondecreasing on the grid, and it can never
  # exceed the net risk of the same readmission model, since removing the competing
  # cause can only take probability away.
  .annexg_score_target <- function(arm) {
    t <- .annexg_target[[arm]]
    if (identical(t$outcome, "mortality")) {
      S <- .annexg_S[[paste0("death__", t$death)]]
      return(ibs_classical_point(.annexg_mk_death(S), horizons = ANNEXG_HORIZONS))
    }
    Sr <- .annexg_S[[paste0("readmit__", t$readmit)]]
    if (identical(t$definition, "net-risk"))
      return(ibs_classical_readmit(.annexg_mk_readmit(Sr), ANNEXG_HORIZONS, method = "aalen-johansen"))
    Sd <- .annexg_S[[paste0("death__", t$death)]]
    cif <- .annexg_cif(Sr, Sd)
    if (any(cif[, -1L, drop = FALSE] + 1e-10 < cif[, -ncol(cif), drop = FALSE]))
      stop("annex-ibs-g: a computed CIF is not nondecreasing for ", arm, ".", call. = FALSE)
    ex <- max(cif - (1 - Sr), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(ex) || ex > 1e-10)
      stop(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: a computed CIF exceeds its net risk for %s by %.3e.", arm, ex), call. = FALSE)
    out <- ibs_classical_readmit(.annexg_mk_readmit(1 - cif), ANNEXG_HORIZONS, method = "aalen-johansen")
    rm(cif); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
    out
  }
  for (arm in .annexg_todo_arms) {
    .annexg_add(arm, .annexg_score_target(arm), .annexg_target[[arm]])
    cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: scored %-52s (%.1f min elapsed)\n", arm,
                (proc.time() - .annexg_t0)[["elapsed"]] / 60)); flush.console()
  }
  .annexg_arm_meta <- do.call(rbind, .annexg_meta); rownames(.annexg_arm_meta) <- NULL
  rm(.annexg_S); invisible(gc())
  saveRDS(list(points = annex_ibsg_points, arm_metadata = .annexg_arm_meta,
               meta = list(grid = ANNEXG_GRID, horizons = ANNEXG_HORIZONS,
                           formula_keys = vapply(.annexg_need, .annexg_key, ""),
                           target_arms = names(.annexg_target),
                           scored_arms = .annexg_todo_arms,
                           n = .annexg_N, created = as.character(Sys.time()))),
          ANNEXG_CACHE)
  cat("annex-ibs-g: cached to ", ANNEXG_CACHE, "\n", sep = "")
}
cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: %d arm(s) scored in this run.\n", length(annex_ibsg_points)))
# ---- 10. Union of scored arms, and the completeness assertion ----------------
# Arms already scored elsewhere are taken exactly as stored: only
# $contrib_trapezoid and $horizons feed the shared bootstrap, so nothing is
# rescored and pred225_annex_ibs_pairwise_all_arms_v2.rds is never written to.
# The union is then checked against the declared inventory, so a table that
# quietly lost a candidate cannot reach the manuscript.
.annexg_all_points <- c(.annexg_have[intersect(names(.annexg_target), names(.annexg_have))],
                        annex_ibsg_points)
.annexg_reused <- intersect(names(.annexg_target), names(.annexg_have))
.annexg_all_meta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(.annexg_all_points), function(a) {
  t <- .annexg_target[[a]]
  data.frame(arm = a, outcome = t$outcome, model = t$model,
             prediction_definition = t$definition, family = t$family,
             source = if (a %in% .annexg_reused) "reused" else "scored here",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(.annexg_all_meta) <- NULL
.annexg_missing <- setdiff(names(.annexg_target), names(.annexg_all_points))
if (length(.annexg_missing))
  stop("annex-ibs-g: the table does not cover the declared inventory. Missing arms: ",
       paste(.annexg_missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: inventory complete, %d arms (%d reused, %d scored here).\n",
            length(.annexg_all_points), length(.annexg_reused), length(annex_ibsg_points)))
print(table(.annexg_all_meta$outcome, .annexg_all_meta$family))
# ---- 11. ONE shared subject bootstrap over every arm ------------------------
# G is fixed by the pooled cohort, so each subject's trapezoided contribution is
# constant and one replicate is a matrix-vector product. Using the SAME resampled
# subjects for every arm in every replicate is what makes all the differences
# below genuinely paired, old against old, new against new, and old against new.
cat(sprintf("annex-ibs-g: shared subject bootstrap, %d arms x %d horizons x B = %d.\n",
            length(.annexg_all_points), length(ANNEXG_HORIZONS), ANNEXG_B)); flush.console()
.annexg_C <- lapply(.annexg_all_points, `[[`, "contrib_trapezoid")
.annexg_h <- as.numeric(ANNEXG_HORIZONS)
set.seed(ANNEXG_SEED, kind = "Mersenne-Twister")
.annexg_boot <- array(NA_real_, c(length(.annexg_C), length(.annexg_h), ANNEXG_B),
                      dimnames = list(names(.annexg_C), as.character(.annexg_h), paste0("b", seq_len(ANNEXG_B))))
for (b in seq_len(ANNEXG_B)) {
  cnt <- tabulate(sample.int(.annexg_N, .annexg_N, replace = TRUE), nbins = .annexg_N)
  for (a in seq_along(.annexg_C))
    .annexg_boot[a, , b] <- as.numeric(cnt %*% .annexg_C[[a]]) / .annexg_N / .annexg_h
  if (b %% 100L == 0L) { cat(sprintf(" %d", b)); flush.console() }
}
cat("\n")
.annexg_q <- function(M, p) apply(M, 1L, function(x) {
  f <- x[is.finite(x)]; if (length(f) < 20L) NA_real_ else stats::quantile(f, probs = p, names = FALSE) })
# ---- 12. Per-arm table, in the layout of ibs_dev_table ----------------------
annex_ibsg_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(.annexg_all_points), function(a) {
  md <- .annexg_all_meta[match(a, .annexg_all_meta$arm), , drop = FALSE]
  bm <- .annexg_boot[a, , , drop = TRUE]
  data.frame(arm = a, family = md$family, outcome = md$outcome, model = md$model,
             estimand = md$prediction_definition,
             horizon_months = .annexg_h, ibs_oof = .annexg_all_points[[a]]$ibs$ibs,
             ibs_lo95 = .annexg_q(bm, 0.025), ibs_hi95 = .annexg_q(bm, 0.975),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
}))
annex_ibsg_table <- annex_ibsg_table[order(annex_ibsg_table$outcome, annex_ibsg_table$horizon_months,
                                           annex_ibsg_table$estimand, annex_ibsg_table$ibs_oof), ]
rownames(annex_ibsg_table) <- NULL
# ---- 13. Paired differences across every arm --------------------------------
.annexg_pairs <- c(
  utils::combn(.annexg_all_meta$arm[.annexg_all_meta$outcome == "readmission"], 2L, simplify = FALSE),
  utils::combn(.annexg_all_meta$arm[.annexg_all_meta$outcome == "mortality"], 2L, simplify = FALSE))
annex_ibsg_pairwise <- do.call(rbind, lapply(.annexg_pairs, function(pr) {
  mA <- .annexg_all_meta[match(pr[1], .annexg_all_meta$arm), , drop = FALSE]
  mB <- .annexg_all_meta[match(pr[2], .annexg_all_meta$arm), , drop = FALSE]
  bA <- .annexg_boot[pr[1], , , drop = TRUE]; bB <- .annexg_boot[pr[2], , , drop = TRUE]
  bd <- bA - bB
  pA <- .annexg_all_points[[pr[1]]]$ibs$ibs; pB <- .annexg_all_points[[pr[2]]]$ibs$ibs
  data.frame(
    outcome = mA$outcome,
    comparison = if (mA$family == mB$family) paste("within", mA$family) else "Cox vs DeepSurv-informed",
    definition_scope = if (mA$outcome == "mortality") "mortality pair"
                       else if (mA$prediction_definition == mB$prediction_definition) "within prediction definition"
                       else "cross prediction definition",
    model_A = mA$model, model_B = mB$model, family_A = mA$family, family_B = mB$family,
    prediction_A = mA$prediction_definition, prediction_B = mB$prediction_definition,
    arm_A = pr[1], arm_B = pr[2], horizon_months = .annexg_h, n = .annexg_N,
    ibs_A = pA, ibs_A_lo = .annexg_q(bA, 0.025), ibs_A_hi = .annexg_q(bA, 0.975),
    ibs_B = pB, ibs_B_lo = .annexg_q(bB, 0.025), ibs_B_hi = .annexg_q(bB, 0.975),
    delta_ibs = pA - pB, delta_lo = .annexg_q(bd, 0.025), delta_hi = .annexg_q(bd, 0.975),
    bootstrap_mean = rowMeans(bd, na.rm = TRUE),
    centering_bias = rowMeans(bd, na.rm = TRUE) - (pA - pB),
    bootstrap_valid = rowSums(is.finite(bd)), bootstrap_requested = ANNEXG_B,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
}))
annex_ibsg_pairwise <- annex_ibsg_pairwise[order(annex_ibsg_pairwise$outcome,
                                                 annex_ibsg_pairwise$horizon_months,
                                                 -abs(annex_ibsg_pairwise$delta_ibs)), ]
rownames(annex_ibsg_pairwise) <- NULL
# ---- 14. Report -------------------------------------------------------------
# delta_ibs = IBS_A - IBS_B, so a NEGATIVE difference favours A: lower prediction
# error is better. That is the opposite sign convention from the delta C tables,
# which is easy to misread, so it is restated here rather than left implicit.
cat("\n== Classical (Graf) IBS, out of fold on development, DeepSurv-informed candidates included ==\n")

            ANNEXG_B, nrow(.annexg_all_meta), length(annex_ibsg_points)))

print(annex_ibsg_table[, c("outcome", "model", "family", "estimand", "horizon_months",
                           "ibs_oof", "ibs_lo95", "ibs_hi95")], row.names = FALSE, digits = 6)
cat("\n-- Cox versus DeepSurv-informed, within the same prediction definition --\n")
.annexg_focus <- annex_ibsg_pairwise[annex_ibsg_pairwise$comparison == "Cox vs DeepSurv-informed" &
                                     annex_ibsg_pairwise$definition_scope != "cross prediction definition", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(.annexg_focus)) {
  print(.annexg_focus[, c("outcome", "model_A", "model_B", "prediction_A", "horizon_months",
                          "ibs_A", "ibs_B", "delta_ibs", "delta_lo", "delta_hi")],
        row.names = FALSE, digits = 6)
  cat(sprintf("\nLargest |delta IBS| between families: %.6f. Judge it against the 0.01 promotion threshold\n",
              max(abs(.annexg_focus$delta_ibs), na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("of the model-selection rule, not against whether the interval excludes zero.\n")
} else {

.t0 <- proc.time()

# --- fallbacks (equal to pipleine, skip if they exist) ---
if (!exists(".dual_cox_safe_concordance")) .dual_cox_safe_concordance <- function(time,event,lp,ymax=NULL){
  ok<-is.finite(time)&is.finite(event)&is.finite(lp); if(sum(ok)<2L) return(NA_real_)
  a<-list(survival::Surv(time[ok],event[ok])~lp[ok],timewt="n/G2",reverse=TRUE); if(!is.null(ymax)) a$ymax<-ymax
  tryCatch(do.call(survival::concordance,a)$concordance,error=function(e) NA_real_) }
.delta_ibs_G_ordered <- function(sf,tt,g_min=.05){
  requested_times<-pmax(as.numeric(tt),0); unique_times<-sort(unique(requested_times))
  g_unique<-as.numeric(summary(sf,times=unique_times,extend=TRUE)$surv)
  if(length(g_unique)!=length(unique_times)) stop("Unexpected censoring-survival lookup length.")
  lookup_index<-match(requested_times,unique_times)
  if(anyNA(lookup_index)) stop("Could not restore patient-time order in IPCW lookup.")
  pmax(g_unique[lookup_index],g_min) }
.ibs_prep <- function(tr_time,tr_event,te_time,eval_times,g_min=.05,eps=1e-8){
  ev<-as.numeric(tr_event); ev[is.na(ev)]<-0; sf<-survival::survfit(survival::Surv(tr_time,1-ev)~1)
  safe<-sf$time[sf$surv>=g_min]; tau<-if(length(safe)) max(safe) else max(eval_times)
  keep<-eval_times<=tau & eval_times<=max(tr_time,na.rm=TRUE); tu<-eval_times[keep]
  Gat<-function(tt) .delta_ibs_G_ordered(sf,tt,g_min)
  list(times_use=tu,keep=keep,gt0=if(length(tu)) 1/Gat(tu) else numeric(0),gT=1/Gat(pmax(te_time-eps,0))) }
ibs_fast <- function(S_keep,te_time,te_event,idx,prep){
  tu<-prep$times_use; if(length(tu)<2L) return(NA_real_)
  Tt<-te_time[idx]; Dt<-te_event[idx]; gT<-prep$gT[idx]; S<-S_keep[idx,,drop=FALSE]
  bs<-vapply(seq_along(tu),function(j){t0<-tu[j];S0<-S[,j];ar<-Tt>t0;fl<-(!ar)&(Dt==1)
    w<-numeric(length(Tt)); w[ar]<-prep$gt0[j]*(1-S0[ar])^2; w[fl]<-gT[fl]*(S0[fl])^2; mean(w,na.rm=TRUE)},numeric(1))
  den<-max(tu)-min(tu); if(!is.finite(den)||den<=0) return(NA_real_)
  sum(diff(tu)*(head(bs,-1L)+tail(bs,-1L))/2)/den }

# --- reassemble OOF across folds -> per-subject, pooled over imputations ---
.cv_extract <- function(res, outcome = c("readmission","death")) {
  outcome <- match.arg(outcome)
  rp <- res$raw_predictions
  if (is.null(rp) || !length(rp)) stop("no raw_predictions (objeto strippeado o calibracion, no dual eval)")
  cfg <- res$config; et <- as.numeric(cfg$eval_times)
  N <- max(vapply(rp, function(b) max(b$original_val_idx), 1L))
  imps <- sort(unique(vapply(rp, function(b) b$imp_idx, 1L)))
  time_v <- rep(NA_real_,N); event_v <- rep(NA_real_,N); lp_imp <- list(); S_imp <- list()
  for (im in imps) {
    lp <- rep(NA_real_,N); S <- matrix(NA_real_,N,length(et))
    for (b in rp) { if (b$imp_idx!=im) next
      o <- b[[outcome]]; if (is.null(o)||!is.null(o$error)||is.null(o$lp_val)) next
      idx <- b$original_val_idx; lp[idx] <- as.numeric(o$lp_val); S[idx,] <- as.matrix(o$surv_val_matrix)
      yv <- o$y_val; time_v[idx] <- as.numeric(yv[,1]); event_v[idx] <- as.numeric(yv[,2]) }
    lp_imp[[length(lp_imp)+1L]] <- lp; S_imp[[length(S_imp)+1L]] <- S }
  list(time=time_v, event=event_v, lp=Reduce(`+`,lp_imp)/length(lp_imp),
       S=Reduce(`+`,S_imp)/length(S_imp), eval_times=et)
}

# --- paired bootstrap on already-extracted markers (align A,Z on common finite subjects) ---
deltaC_boot_x <- function(A, Z, B=2000L, seed=2125L, ymax=NULL) {
  ok <- is.finite(A$lp)&is.finite(Z$lp)&is.finite(A$time)&is.finite(A$event)
  ti<-A$time[ok]; ev<-A$event[ok]; la<-A$lp[ok]; lz<-Z$lp[ok]; n<-sum(ok); i0<-seq_len(n)
  cc <- function(m,idx) .dual_cox_safe_concordance(ti[idx],ev[idx],m[idx],ymax)
  cA<-cc(la,i0); cZ<-cc(lz,i0); set.seed(seed); d<-numeric(B)
  for (b in seq_len(B)) { idx<-sample.int(n,n,TRUE); d[b]<-cc(la,idx)-cc(lz,idx) }
  q<-quantile(d,c(.025,.975),na.rm=TRUE,names=FALSE)
  data.frame(C_A=round(cA,4),C_B=round(cZ,4),dC=round(cA-cZ,4),
             dC_lo=round(q[1],4),dC_hi=round(q[2],4),excludes_0=isTRUE(q[1]>0||q[2]<0),n=n) }
deltaIBS_boot_x <- function(A, Z, B=2000L, seed=2125L) {
  ok <- is.finite(A$lp)&is.finite(Z$lp)&is.finite(A$time)&is.finite(A$event) &
        rowSums(is.finite(A$S))==ncol(A$S) & rowSums(is.finite(Z$S))==ncol(Z$S)
  ti<-A$time[ok]; ev<-A$event[ok]; SA<-A$S[ok,,drop=FALSE]; SZ<-Z$S[ok,,drop=FALSE]
  prep<-.ibs_prep(ti,ev,ti,A$eval_times)                 # G del censurado de la cohorte OOF
  SAk<-SA[,prep$keep,drop=FALSE]; SZk<-SZ[,prep$keep,drop=FALSE]; n<-nrow(SAk); i0<-seq_len(n)
  iA<-ibs_fast(SAk,ti,ev,i0,prep); iZ<-ibs_fast(SZk,ti,ev,i0,prep); set.seed(seed); d<-numeric(B)
  for (b in seq_len(B)) { idx<-sample.int(n,n,TRUE); d[b]<-ibs_fast(SAk,ti,ev,idx,prep)-ibs_fast(SZk,ti,ev,idx,prep) }
  q<-quantile(d,c(.025,.975),na.rm=TRUE,names=FALSE)
  data.frame(IBS_A=round(iA,4),IBS_B=round(iZ,4),dIBS=round(iA-iZ,4),
             dIBS_lo=round(q[1],4),dIBS_hi=round(q[2],4),excludes_0=isTRUE(q[1]>0||q[2]<0),n=n) }

# Behavioral guard: patient order must not change the censoring lookup.
.sf_guard<-survival::survfit(survival::Surv(c(1,2,3,4),c(1,0,1,0))~1)
.tt_guard<-c(3,1,3,2); .ord_guard<-order(.tt_guard)
stopifnot(identical(.delta_ibs_G_ordered(.sf_guard,.tt_guard),
  .delta_ibs_G_ordered(.sf_guard,.tt_guard[.ord_guard])[match(seq_along(.tt_guard),.ord_guard)]))
rm(.sf_guard,.tt_guard,.ord_guard)

.p225_calibration_workers <- function() {                                                                                               
  detected_cores <- suppressWarnings(parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE))                                                             
  if (!is.finite(detected_cores) || detected_cores < 1L) {                                                                              
    detected_cores <- 4L                                                                                                                
  }                                                                                                                                     
  local_powerful_profile <- identical(as.character(getRversion()), "4.4.1") && detected_cores >= 10L                                    
  if (exists("sistrat_env_profile", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {                                                            
    local_powerful_profile <- local_powerful_profile && identical(get("sistrat_env_profile", envir = .GlobalEnv), "renv_local")         
  }                                                                                                                                     
  workers <- if (local_powerful_profile) {                                                                                              
    min(12L, max(1L, detected_cores - 4L))                                                                                              
  } else if (detected_cores < 10L) {                                                                                                    
    min(4L, max(1L, detected_cores - 2L))                                                                                               
  } else {

    flush.console()

  output

.run_mortality_calibrations <- function() {                                                                                             
  previous_max_size <- getOption("future.globals.maxSize")                                                                              
  on.exit({                                                                                                                             
    future::plan(future::sequential)                                                                                                    
    options(future.globals.maxSize = previous_max_size)

  flat_output <- vector("list", length(death_models_for_cal))                                                                           
  full_output <- vector("list", length(death_models_for_cal))                                                                           
  names(flat_output) <- names(death_models_for_cal)                                                                                     
  names(full_output) <- names(death_models_for_cal)                                                                                     
  for (model_name in names(death_models_for_cal)) {

      formula = model_specification$formula,                                                                                            
      data = py_corrected_datasets_boot,                                                                                                
      times = c(6, 12, 36, 60),                                                                                                         
      time_col = "death_time_from_disch_m",                                                                                             
      event_col = "death_event",                                                                                                        
      validation = "cv",

      verbose = TRUE,                                                                                                                   
      seed = 2125L                                                                                                                      
    )                                                                                                                                   
    if (!is.list(result) || is.null(result$pooled_summary) || is.null(result$flat)) {                                                   
      stop("Mortality calibration returned an incomplete object for ", model_name, ".", call. = FALSE)                                  
    }                                                                                                                                   
    required_summary_columns <- c("time_months", "ici_mean", "ici_sd", "ece_mean", "eo_mean")                                           
    missing_summary_columns <- setdiff(required_summary_columns, names(result$pooled_summary))                                          
    if (length(missing_summary_columns) > 0L) {                                                                                         
      stop("Mortality calibration output for ", model_name, " is missing: ", paste(missing_summary_columns, collapse = ", "), call. =   
      FALSE)                                                                                                                            
    }                                                                                                                                   
    flat_output[[model_name]] <- result$flat                                                                                            
    full_output[[model_name]] <- result                                                                                                 
    cat(sprintf("Completed mortality calibration: %s\n", model_specification$label))                                                    
    print(result$pooled_summary[, required_summary_columns, drop = FALSE])                                                              
    flush.console()                                                                                                                     
    rm(result)                                                                                                                          
    gc(verbose = FALSE)                                                                                                                 
  }                                                                                                                                     
  list(flat = flat_output, full = full_output)                                                                                          
}

library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)
tnr <- "Times New Roman"

create_cal_published <- function(data, time_title,
                                 color = "#2166AC",
                                 x_lim = c(0, 0.4), x_by = 0.1,
                                 y_lim = x_lim,     y_by = x_by,
                                 show_x_label = FALSE, show_y_label = FALSE) {
  fixed_margin <- ggplot2::margin(5, 2, 5, 5)

  .label_fmt <- function(lim)
    scales::number_format(accuracy = ifelse(diff(lim) <= 0.02, 0.001,
                                     ifelse(diff(lim) <= 0.2,  0.01, 0.1)))

  main <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = mean_predicted, y = observed)) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed",
                         color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = observed_lower, ymax = observed_upper),
                         alpha = 0.3, fill = color) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(color = color, linewidth = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = observed_lower, ymax = observed_upper),
                           width = 0.02 * diff(x_lim), color = color,
                           alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1, color = color, fill = "white",
                        shape = 21, stroke = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim, expand = c(0, 0),
                                 breaks = seq(x_lim[1], x_lim[2], by = x_by),
                                 labels = .label_fmt(x_lim)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim, expand = c(0, 0),
                                 breaks = seq(y_lim[1], y_lim[2], by = y_by),
                                 labels = .label_fmt(y_lim)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Predicted probability", y = "Observed proportion",
                  subtitle = time_title) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 15, base_family = tnr) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.subtitle    = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "mm"),
      axis.text        = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.title       = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x     = ggplot2::element_text(
        color = if (show_x_label) "black" else NA, size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y     = ggplot2::element_text(
        color = if (show_y_label) "black" else NA, size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin      = fixed_margin
    )

  right_dens <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = observed)) +
    ggplot2::geom_density(fill = color, alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = y_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5, 5, 5, 0))

  bottom_dens <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = mean_predicted)) +
    ggplot2::geom_density(fill = color, alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 2, 0, 5))

  design <- c(
    patchwork::area(t = 1, l = 1, b = 10, r = 10),
    patchwork::area(t = 1, l = 11, b = 10, r = 11),
    patchwork::area(t = 11, l = 1, b = 11, r = 10)
  )
  main + right_dens + bottom_dens + patchwork::plot_layout(design = design)
}

.make_cal_panel <- function(cal_obj, color, x_lim, x_by,
                            y_lim = x_lim, y_by = x_by) {
  curves <- cal_obj$calibration_curves
  if ("observed_min" %in% names(curves) && !"observed_lower" %in% names(curves)) {
    curves$observed_lower <- curves$observed_min
    curves$observed_upper <- curves$observed_max
  }
  curves <- dplyr::mutate(curves, time_label = paste0(time_months, " months"))
  time_levels <- paste0(sort(unique(curves$time_months)), " months")
  n_plots <- length(time_levels); n_cols <- 4L; n_rows <- ceiling(n_plots / n_cols)

  plots <- lapply(seq_along(time_levels), function(i) {
    col_idx <- (i - 1L) %% n_cols
    row_idx <- (i - 1L) %/% n_cols
    show_y  <- col_idx == 0L
    is_last <- row_idx == (n_rows - 1L)
    n_last  <- n_plots - (n_rows - 1L) * n_cols
    show_x  <- is_last && col_idx == floor((n_last - 1L) / 2L)
    create_cal_published(
      dplyr::filter(curves, time_label == time_levels[i]),
      time_levels[i], color = color,
      x_lim = x_lim, x_by = x_by,
      y_lim = y_lim, y_by = y_by,
      show_x_label = show_x, show_y_label = show_y
    )
  })
  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = n_cols) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 10, 10)))
}

ds_rdata <- list.files(
  file.path(project_root, "data", "20241015_out"),
  pattern = "pred24_ndp_.*\\.Rdata$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

ds_formulas_available <- FALSE

if (length(ds_rdata) > 0) {
  # Load only DS formulas (without overwriting py_corrected_datasets)
  env_ds <- new.env()
  load(ds_rdata[length(ds_rdata)], envir = env_ds)
  
  ds_formula_names <- ls(env_ds, pattern = "formula_shap_ds_")
  cat("DS formulas found:\n")
  for (fn in ds_formula_names) {
    cat(sprintf("  - %s\n", fn))
    assign(fn, get(fn, envir = env_ds), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  
  if (length(ds_formula_names) > 0) {
    ds_formulas_available <- TRUE
  }
} else {
  cat("No prediction24 .Rdata file found.\n")
  cat("If necessary, define DS formulas manually from prediction24_converted.ipynb.\n")
}

# --- Helper to extract metrics from an evaluate_dual_cox_python_style object ---
extract_dual_metrics <- function(obj, model_id, family) {
  if (is.null(obj) || !is.list(obj) || is.null(obj$summary)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  s <- obj$summary
  
  # Global
  row_global <- s[s$Time == "Global", ]
  
  # Dual UnoC = (UnoC_readmit + UnoC_death) / 2
  unoc_r <- row_global$mean[row_global$Metric == "Uno's C-Index" & row_global$Risk == "Readmission"]
  unoc_d <- row_global$mean[row_global$Metric == "Uno's C-Index" & row_global$Risk == "Death"]
  dual_unoC <- if (length(unoc_r) == 1 && length(unoc_d) == 1) (unoc_r + unoc_d) / 2 else NA
  
  # Dual IBS = (IBS_readmit + IBS_death) / 2
  ibs_r <- row_global$mean[row_global$Metric == "IBS" & row_global$Risk == "Readmission"]
  ibs_d <- row_global$mean[row_global$Metric == "IBS" & row_global$Risk == "Death"]
  dual_ibs <- if (length(ibs_r) == 1 && length(ibs_d) == 1) (ibs_r + ibs_d) / 2 else NA
  
  # By horizon (d_C_T, d_IBS_T)
  d_C_T <- list()
  d_IBS_T <- list()
  for (t in c("6", "12", "36", "60")) {
    s_t <- s[s$Time == t, ]
    if (nrow(s_t) > 0) {
      c_r <- s_t$mean[s_t$Metric == "Uno's C-Index" & s_t$Risk == "Readmission"]
      c_d <- s_t$mean[s_t$Metric == "Uno's C-Index" & s_t$Risk == "Death"]
      d_C_T[[t]] <- if (length(c_r) == 1 && length(c_d) == 1) (c_r + c_d) / 2 else NA
      
      ibs_r <- s_t$mean[s_t$Metric == "IBS" & s_t$Risk == "Readmission"]
      ibs_d <- s_t$mean[s_t$Metric == "IBS" & s_t$Risk == "Death"]
      d_IBS_T[[t]] <- if (length(ibs_r) == 1 && length(ibs_d) == 1) (ibs_r + ibs_d) / 2 else NA
    }
  }
  
  # Pooled individual
  unoc_readmit <- if (length(unoc_r) == 1) unoc_r else NA
  unoc_death <- if (length(unoc_d) == 1) unoc_d else NA
  ibs_readmit <- if (length(ibs_r) == 1) ibs_r else NA
  ibs_death <- if (length(ibs_d) == 1) ibs_d else NA
  
  data.frame(
    model_id = model_id,
    family = family,
    dual_UnoC = round(dual_unoC, 4),
    dual_IBS = round(dual_ibs, 4),
    d_C_6 = round(d_C_T[["6"]], 4),
    d_C_12 = round(d_C_T[["12"]], 4),
    d_C_36 = round(d_C_T[["36"]], 4),
    d_C_60 = round(d_C_T[["60"]], 4),
    d_IBS_6 = round(d_IBS_T[["6"]], 4),
    d_IBS_12 = round(d_IBS_T[["12"]], 4),
    d_IBS_36 = round(d_IBS_T[["36"]], 4),
    d_IBS_60 = round(d_IBS_T[["60"]], 4),
    UnoC_readmit = round(unoc_readmit, 4),
    UnoC_death = round(unoc_death, 4),
    IBS_readmit = round(ibs_readmit, 4),
    IBS_death = round(ibs_death, 4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Derive the compact per-horizon format (what plot_dca_multi_horizon expects)
# from the already-computed summaries Ã¢â‚¬â€ NO recomputation. Identical to what
# compute_dca_from_boot() would return (same run_adca config, same thresholds).
.dca_compact_from_full <- function(models_full, risk, horizons,
                                   thresholds = seq(0.01, 0.60, by = 0.01)) {
  out <- stats::setNames(vector("list", length(horizons)), as.character(horizons))
  for (h in horizons) {
    per_model <- lapply(models_full, function(m) {
      if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
      if (!(h %in% as.numeric(m$config$horizons))) return(NULL)
      .dca_extract_horizon(m, risk, h, thresholds)
    })
    out[[as.character(h)]] <- stats::setNames(per_model, names(models_full))
  }
  out
}

# Standardized-net-benefit variant of make_dca_panel_figure().
# Standalone: does NOT modify the shared make_dca_panel_figure() in
# dca_from_results_boot_for_metrics.R, so other callers stay intact.
# What changed vs the original:
#   - y axis = standardized net benefit = net_benefit_mean / observed event rate,
#     so the model curve is visible and comparable across horizons.
#   - x axis truncated per outcome (data-driven from the focus windows); high
#     thresholds are clinically irrelevant for rare outcomes (death stays tight).
#   - y axis cropped to the meaningful range; "treat all" may run off the bottom.
#   - a caption note below the plot states the standardization.

make_dca_panel_figure_std <- function(
    summary_full,
    summary_ml,
    outcome  = c("death", "readmission"),
    horizons = c(6, 12, 36, 60),
    x_limits = NULL,             # NULL = data-driven from the focus windows
    y_limits = c(-0.2, 1.03)     # standardized scale: 1.0 = treat-all at threshold 0
) {
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE))
  outcome <- match.arg(outcome)

  full_dat <- summary_full; full_dat$model_panel <- "A"
  ml_dat   <- summary_ml;   ml_dat$model_panel   <- "B"
  plot_dat <- rbind.data.frame(full_dat, ml_dat)
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[plot_dat$risk %in% outcome &
                         plot_dat$horizon %in% horizons, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(plot_dat)) stop("No rows for the requested outcome/horizons.", call. = FALSE)

  # Standardized net benefit = net benefit / event prevalence at the horizon.
  prev <- plot_dat$observed_event_risk_mean
  plot_dat$std_nb <- ifelse(is.finite(prev) & prev > 0,
                            plot_dat$net_benefit_mean / prev, NA_real_)

  plot_dat$strategy_plot <- factor(plot_dat$strategy,
                                   levels = c("Model", "Treat all", "Treat none"))
  plot_dat$model_panel   <- factor(plot_dat$model_panel, levels = c("A", "B"))
  plot_dat$horizon       <- factor(plot_dat$horizon, levels = horizons)

  focus_dat <- plot_dat[!duplicated(plot_dat[, c("model_panel", "horizon",
                                                 "focus_lower", "focus_upper")]), ,
                        drop = FALSE]

  # Data-driven x truncation: cover the focus windows + margin, capped at 0.5
  # (death collapses to a tight low-threshold range; readmission keeps its width).
  if (is.null(x_limits)) {
    x_hi <- min(0.5, max(focus_dat$focus_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.3)
    x_limits <- c(0, x_hi)
  }

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_rect(
      data = focus_dat,
      ggplot2::aes(xmin = focus_lower, xmax = focus_upper, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.18, color = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = plot_dat,
      ggplot2::aes(x = threshold, y = std_nb,
                   linetype = strategy_plot, linewidth = strategy_plot)
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(
      model_panel ~ horizon, switch = "y",
      labeller = ggplot2::labeller(horizon = function(x) paste0(x, " months"))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("Model" = "solid", "Treat all" = "dotted", "Treat none" = "dotdash")
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_linewidth_manual(
      values = c("Model" = 0.9, "Treat all" = 0.6, "Treat none" = 0.6)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits, clip = "on") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Threshold probability",
      y = "Standardized net benefit",
      linetype = NULL, linewidth = NULL)+
    #   caption = paste(
    #     "Standardized net benefit = net benefit / observed event rate at each horizon",
    #     "(1.0 = treating everyone at threshold 0). The 'treat all' curve may fall below the",
    #     "displayed range. Shaded band: plausible threshold window (0.5x to 2x the event rate).",
    #     sep = "\n")
    # ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      legend.box        = "horizontal",
      strip.background  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.placement   = "outside",
      strip.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text         = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title        = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain"),
      panel.spacing     = ggplot2::unit(0.9, "lines"),
      plot.caption      = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10, face = "italic")
    )
}

out_dir  <- file.path(project_root, "data", "20241015_out")
out_stem <- sprintf("pred225_metrics_%s", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y_%m_%d"))

# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ Strip individual-level data before saving Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬
# Handles a single result object (has $raw_predictions directly) OR
# a named list of result objects (each element may have $raw_predictions).
.strip_raw <- function(obj) {
  if (!is.list(obj)) return(obj)
  if ("raw_predictions" %in% names(obj)) {        # single result object
    obj$raw_predictions <- NULL
    return(obj)
  }
  lapply(obj, function(m) {                        # named list of results
    if (is.list(m) && "raw_predictions" %in% names(m)) m$raw_predictions <- NULL
    m
  })
}
# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ Formulas Ã¢â‚¬â€ pred21/22 always saved these; small, no patient data Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬
formula_names_all <- c(
  "formula_readmit",               "formula_readmit_updated",    "formula_readmit_updated2",
  "formula_death",                 "formula_death_updated",      "formula_death_updated2",
  "formula_shap_readmit_clean",    "formula_shap_readmit_clean_updated",
  "formula_shap_readmit_interact",
  "formula_shap_death",            "formula_shap_death_interact", 
  "formula_shap_ds_readmit_clean_updated", "formula_shap_ds_readmit_interact",
  "formula_shap_ds_death_updated", "formula_shap_ds_death_interact"
)
formulas_agg <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
  setNames(
    lapply(formula_names_all, function(fn) if (exists(fn)) get(fn) else NULL),
    formula_names_all
  )
)
# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ Primary eval results loaded from pred22 Ã¢â‚¬â€ strip raw_predictions Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬
# These were saved by save.image() in pred22 and contain individual patient data.
# results_upd2_py               = Full PH updated2 (readmit + death)
# results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf   = SHAP clean (primary model)
# results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf3  = SHAP readmit + interact
# results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf2 = implementation combo:
# formula_shap_readmit_clean_updated + formula_shap_death
pred22_results_agg <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  results_upd2_py = if (exists("results_upd2_py"))
    .strip_raw(results_upd2_py) else NULL,
  results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf = if (exists("results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf"))
    .strip_raw(results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf) else NULL,
  results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf2 = if (exists("results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf2"))
    .strip_raw(results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf2) else NULL,
  results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf3 = if (exists("results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf3"))
    .strip_raw(results_shap_xgb_py_upd_best_perf3) else NULL
))
# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ DCA bundle Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬
dca_agg <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  models_full    = if (exists("dca_models_full"))          dca_models_full          else NULL,
  nb_full_ph     = if (exists("dca_nb_full_ph"))           dca_nb_full_ph           else NULL,
  nb_shap_clean  = if (exists("dca_nb_shap_clean"))        dca_nb_shap_clean        else NULL,
  nb_implemented = if (exists("dca_nb_shap_implemented"))  dca_nb_shap_implemented  else NULL,
  dca_readmit    = if (exists("dca_readmit"))              dca_readmit              else NULL,
  dca_death      = if (exists("dca_death"))                dca_death                else NULL
))
if (length(dca_agg) == 0L) dca_agg <- NULL
# NRI/IDI and threshold metrics - compact, no raw replicate payload
.nri_idi_compact <- function(x) {
  if (!is.list(x)) return(x)
  Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
    summary = x$summary,
    config  = x$config
  ))
}
.threshold_compact <- function(x) {
  if (!is.list(x)) return(x)
  Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
    summary_long = x$summary_long,
    summary_wide = x$summary_wide,
    thresholds   = x$thresholds,
    config       = x$config
  ))
}
.get_if_exists <- function(nm) {
  if (exists(nm, inherits = TRUE)) get(nm, inherits = TRUE) else NULL
}
nri_idi_object_names <- c(
  best2    = "nri_idi_best2",
  best2vs1 = "nri_idi_best2vs1"
)
nri_idi_agg <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
  lapply(nri_idi_object_names, function(nm) {
    x <- .get_if_exists(nm)
    if (is.null(x)) NULL else .nri_idi_compact(x)
  })
)
nri_idi_table_names <- c(
  best2    = "nri_idi_model_table",
  best2vs1 = "nri_idi_model_table2"
)
nri_idi_tables_agg <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
  lapply(nri_idi_table_names, .get_if_exists)
)
# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ Bundle all aggregate results Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬
results_agg <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  # Model definitions (needed to reproduce any fit)
  formulas           = if (length(formulas_agg) > 0L) formulas_agg else NULL,
  # Primary pred22 eval results, stripped (same coverage as pred22 save.image but safe)
  pred22_results     = if (length(pred22_results_agg) > 0L) pred22_results_agg else NULL,
  # Calibration: readmission (pooled_summary, rep_results, flat, calibration_curves)
  cal_readmit        = if (exists("cal_results"))       cal_results       else NULL,
  # Calibration: death
  cal_death_flat     = if (exists("death_cal_results")) death_cal_results else NULL,
  cal_death_full     = if (exists("death_cal_full"))    death_cal_full    else NULL,
  # Dual metrics from this notebook (strip raw_predictions)
  dual_pending       = if (exists("dual_pending_results")) .strip_raw(dual_pending_results) else NULL,
  ds_dual            = if (exists("ds_dual_results"))      .strip_raw(ds_dual_results)      else NULL,
  # Add to results_agg bundle (after cal_death_full):
  cal_readmit_ds     = if (exists("cal_results_ds"))        cal_results_ds        else NULL,
  cal_death_ds_flat  = if (exists("death_cal_results_ds"))  death_cal_results_ds  else NULL,
  cal_death_ds_full  = if (exists("death_cal_full_ds"))     death_cal_full_ds     else NULL,
  # DCA (aggregate net-benefit tables only)
  dca                = dca_agg,
  # Summary tables
  ici_readmit_table  = if (exists("ici_readmit_table"))   ici_readmit_table   else NULL,
  ici_death_table    = if (exists("ici_death_table"))     ici_death_table     else NULL,
  consolidated_table = if (exists("consolidated_table"))  consolidated_table  else NULL,
  # Article-2 authoritative selection objects (section 8)
  model_registry        = if (exists("model_registry"))        model_registry        else NULL,
  supp_model_comparison = if (exists("supp_model_comparison")) supp_model_comparison else NULL,
  nri_idi        = if (length(nri_idi_agg) > 0L) nri_idi_agg else NULL,
  nri_idi_tables = if (length(nri_idi_tables_agg) > 0L) nri_idi_tables_agg else NULL,
  threshold_metrics  = if (exists("threshold_out_best2")) .threshold_compact(threshold_out_best2) else NULL,
  threshold_table    = if (exists("thr_tbl")) thr_tbl else NULL,
  # Delta C-index (2026-07-13)
  delta_fits       = if (exists("dual_fits"))        .strip_raw(dual_fits)       else NULL,
  delta_tbl        = if (exists("delta_tbl"))        delta_tbl                  else NULL,
  delta_C_risk_tbl = if (exists("delta_C_risk_table")) delta_C_risk_table       else NULL
))

# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ RDS: single named list, no namespace pollution on load Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬

saveRDS(results_agg, rds_path)
cat("Saved RDS:", rds_path, "\n")

# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ CSV exports for flat tables Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬
csv_dir <- file.path(project_root, "cons", "_out")
if (!dir.exists(csv_dir)) dir.create(csv_dir, recursive = TRUE)

csv_exports <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  ici_readmit_multihorizonte = if (exists("ici_readmit_table"))   ici_readmit_table   else NULL,
  ici_death_multihorizonte   = if (exists("ici_death_table"))     ici_death_table     else NULL,

# Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ Summary Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬

check_quarto_version <- function(required = "1.7.29", comparator = c("ge","gt","le","lt","eq")) {
  comparator <- match.arg(comparator)
  current <- package_version(paste(unlist(quarto::quarto_version()), collapse = "."))
  req     <- package_version(required)
  ok <- switch(comparator,
               ge = current >= req,
               gt = current >  req,
               le = current <= req,
               lt = current <  req,
               eq = current == req)
  if (!ok) {
    stop(sprintf("Quarto version check failed: need %s %s (installed: %s).",
                 comparator, required, current), call. = FALSE)

  invisible(TRUE)

find_latest_file <- function(project_root, prefix) {
  # Get all files matching the pattern
  pattern <- paste0(prefix, "_\\d{8}_\\d{4}\\.csv$")
  files <- list.files(
    path = project_root,
    pattern = pattern,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No files found matching pattern:", pattern))
  }
  # Extract timestamps from filenames (format: YYYYMMDD_HHMM)
  extract_timestamp <- function(filename) {
    matches <- regmatches(
      basename(filename),
      gregexpr("\\d{8}_\\d{4}", basename(filename))
    )
    if (length(matches[[1]]) == 0) {
      return(NA)
    }
    timestamp_str <- matches[[1]][length(matches[[1]])]
    return(timestamp_str)
  }
  timestamps <- sapply(files, extract_timestamp)
  # Remove any files where timestamp extraction failed
  valid_idx <- !is.na(timestamps)
  files <- files[valid_idx]
  timestamps <- timestamps[valid_idx]
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop("No valid timestamps found in filenames")
  }
  # Sort by timestamp (descending) and return the latest
  latest_idx <- order(timestamps, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
  return(files[latest_idx])
}
